name: RestoreBackup
transaction_boundary: cryptographic/database verification completes in isolated staging before quiesce; current live database is first preserved as verified emergency recovery copy; replacement uses LLD-01 atomic recovery choreography; restored-job/catalog reconciliation plus command receipt/audit form one recovery-finalization UnitOfWork before READY, and any finalization failure rolls back to prior verified live state when possible
authoritative_reads: exact artifact digest and preview fingerprint
restored durable-job and managed-backup-catalog technical state after replacement
guards: staged SQLCipher DB passes schema/migration/FK/audit checks
managed restore source backup_id exists in restored managed_backup_catalog as required by managed-backup creation chronology
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 plus restore operation identity; committed restored data_instance_id/backup_id receipt prevents duplicate replacement and replay never reruns recovery reconciliation
receipt_order: preflight outside UoW -> acquire exclusive recovery state -> emergency verified backup -> verify again -> recoverable live-database/key-envelope replacement -> reopen/verify restored DB -> BEGIN recovery-finalization UnitOfWork -> reconcile restored nonterminal durable jobs -> reconcile restored managed-backup catalog technical state -> command_receipt -> security.backup_restored audit/result refs -> COMMIT -> remove recovery marker -> permit readiness
mutations: create and retain a verified emergency pre-restore managed-backup identity when current live state exists
atomically replace live authoritative database and target-installation protected live-DEK envelope from the fully verified stage
cancel historical restored nonterminal durable jobs through LLD-01 restore reconciliation before READY

for managed restore, transition authenticated source backup catalog row to restored and revision+1; transition other restored building/verifying backup rows to failed with RESTORE_SNAPSHOT_JOB_INVALIDATED and revision+1
append restore command receipt/audit/result evidence inside the restored database
revision_effects: restored business/domain entity revisions and restored data_instance_id remain exactly as carried by the verified backup; restore does not synthesize business revision increments; only explicitly reconciled technical managed_backup_catalog rows increment revision by 1, a newly created emergency backup uses its normal creation revision, and job coordination/audit/receipt rows follow their Foundation technical contracts
post_commit_work: remove recovery marker, clean isolated staging/recovery temporaries best-effort, and allow next readiness cycle to generate fresh run/session identities; retain emergency pre-restore backup until normal verified-backup retention later proves it eligible
rules: no live mutation before complete verification
failed recovery finalization restores prior verified database/key envelope when possible and otherwise keeps runtime non-READY
portable source DPAPI state is never required because encrypted payload carries source live DEK
historical queued/retry/waiting/running jobs are never automatically resumed after restore
